description: In Mead, WA, formally known as Yaryan's. raises Apples, Peaches, Nectarines, Apricots, and Plums on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
